description: GlobalBuildingAtlas is an open global dataset of building polygons, building heights and level-of-detail 1 (LoD1) 3D building models, derived by machine learning from satellite imagery and combined with existing footprint sources such as OpenStreetMap and Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints. It is produced by the Technical University of Munich group of Xiao Xiang Zhu and described in Earth System Science Data (volume 17, 2025). Coverage aims at every country, territory and city, although some areas are absent or lack heights because of data-quality limits. Access: three parts, ODbL-derived polygons and LoD1 files on Hugging Face and height maps on mediaTUM, with scripts in the repository to assemble LoD1 GeoJSON; polygons are in EPSG:3857; a web viewer is for visualisation only and must not be scraped. Licence: the dataset is split because of licence conflicts, with ODbL polygons and CC BY-NC 4.0 polygons, LoD1 models and height maps; combining them may have licence implications, and downloading implies acceptance of the terms of use. Free for non-commercial use of the NC parts. Caveats: heights and footprints are machine-derived and contain errors; the non-commercial licence limits some uses. Simulation uses are global building exposure with height for hazard and resilience studies and LoD1 city models for digital twins. Related records: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints and Overture Maps buildings.
